title: Inspect recent Unity Console logs
summary: Read recent errors and warnings before taking other debugging steps.
goal: Use the current Console output to understand the latest editor failures or warnings.
whenToUse: A command failed and you want the latest error context.
You need a quick debugging snapshot without changing project state.
prerequisites: The Unity Editor is open and the bridge is running.
steps: Start with a small maxEntries value such as 5 or 10.
Restrict logTypes to error,warning when you only care about failures.
Turn includeStackTrace on when the short message is not enough.

exampleCommands.title: Read the latest warning and error entries

title: Run a custom editor script
summary: Use Unity_RunCommand when no dedicated tool matches the task.
goal: Execute a focused C# editor automation script inside Unity.
whenToUse: You need to inspect or mutate Unity state in a custom way.
A dedicated tool is missing for the task.
prerequisites: Prepare a script that uses the CommandScript golden template.
steps: Write an internal CommandScript class that implements IRunCommand.
Register creations, modifications, and deletions through the ExecutionResult object.
Run the script with a short Title so it is easy to identify in output.

title: Capture the Unity Editor UI
summary: Capture the current editor window layout as an image.
goal: Gather visual context from the editor UI when text tools are insufficient.
whenToUse: A visual problem is visible in the editor UI.
You want a snapshot of the current focused editor windows.
prerequisites: The target windows are visible in the editor.
steps: Arrange the relevant editor windows before capturing.
Run the screenshot tool once and inspect the returned image.

title: Capture a specific camera view
summary: Render an image from a chosen camera for scene validation.
goal: Inspect what a particular scene camera sees without changing the scene.
whenToUse: You already know the target camera instance ID.
The scene view does not match the actual gameplay camera.
prerequisites: Know the GameObject instance ID of the camera to capture.
steps: Identify the camera instance ID.
Pass the cameraInstanceID argument to the capture tool.
Use the result image to validate placement or framing.

title: Capture the Scene View from multiple angles
summary: Get a 2x2 multi-angle image for a 3D scene review.
goal: Understand 3D scene structure from several viewpoints at once.
whenToUse: A single scene screenshot is not enough.
You need a broad 3D layout overview.
prerequisites: The project uses a meaningful 3D Scene View.
steps: Prepare the Scene View at the area you want to inspect.
Run the multi-angle capture tool.
Use the four-view result to reason about scene layout.

exampleCommands.title: Capture the current Scene View from four angles

title: List available asset generation models
summary: Inspect which generation models are available before choosing one.
goal: Get valid model IDs for downstream asset generation commands.
whenToUse: You are about to generate an asset and need a model ID.
You want to inspect the generation inventory.
prerequisites: Asset generation is configured for the project.
steps: Call the model listing tool.
Record the model ID you want to use for generation.

title: Generate an asset with the generation backend
summary: Choose a model and run the asset generation tool with the right command payload.
goal: Create or modify a Unity asset through the generation backend.
whenToUse: You want Unity to generate a new asset from a prompt.
You want to edit an existing generated asset.
prerequisites: Know whether the generation command creates a new asset or edits an existing one.
steps: List available generation models and choose a model ID.
Pick the GenerateAsset command that matches the asset type you want.
Provide savePath for new assets or targetAssetPath for edits.
Set waitForCompletion when the caller should block for the finished job.

exampleCommands.title: Generate a sprite asset
exampleCommands.command: unity-ai-cli call Unity_AssetGeneration_GenerateAsset --json-args '{"command":"GenerateSprite","modelId":"<model-id>","prompt":"A stylized wooden crate icon","savePath":"Assets/Generated/crate.png","waitForCompletion":true}'
